title: High School Robot
log: Custom VEX-style robot I designed and built in high school. Includes build photo + test run footage in one archive slide.

title: Pitch Competition
log: Placed 1st at the 2025 Cal Poly Elevator Pitch Competition with a 90-second live pitch for Communicare, an AI communication coach. Framed market viability, technical scalability, and AI integration under high pressure, then handled judge Q&A in real time. Secured $1,000 in seed funding/prize money and turned a compressed prep window into a complete deliverable sprint.

title: Clash Royale Tournament
log: Directed Cal Poly's first 2v2 Clash Royale tournament and handled logistics for 12 teams (30+ attendees), including venue planning and bracket operations. Drove turnout with multi-channel promotion across flyers, Discord, and social channels, while also organizing prize incentives. During the event, resolved live connectivity issues and kept match flow stable to maintain competitive pacing.

title: Mustang Market Launch
log: Built and launched Mustang Market in a team of 3 over a two-week sprint from planning to public release. Reached 3,000+ visitors and 500+ users in the first 10 days, then pushed growth with social content that generated 50,000+ views. Ran fast post-launch feedback loops to prioritize fixes and feature iteration while usage was actively scaling.

title: Vocaview
log: Deployed a browser extension + web app using a Vite, Supabase, Render, and Vercel stack. Built Figma wireframes and demo reels to reduce onboarding friction for early users and clarify product flow. Launch metrics hit 150+ visitors and 10+ users in week one, then grew to +150% visitors and +400% page views over the first two months.
